create_nested_tensor: create a NestedTensor object from a batch of tensors and an optional boolean mask
nested_tensor_from_tensor_list: build a NestedTensor by padding a list of 3D image tensors to a uniform batch shape
nested_tensor_decompose: decompose a NestedTensor into its underlying tensors and mask components
nested_tensor_to_device: move a NestedTensor and its mask to a specified device like cuda or cpu
check_dist_initialized: check if PyTorch distributed is available and initialized for multi-GPU training
